verdict.rationale: Version-control friendliness and team collaboration are fair questions for a game engine, so this axis applies. The evidence pack does not mention mergeable scenes, diffable text project formats, VCS integration, or built-in multi-user editing. The project-scope MCP config file and sharing builds with friends for playtesting are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the project format and tooling play well with version control and multi-person teams — mergeable scenes, diffable text formats, or built-in collaboration
